Japan-Manchoukuo Year Book 1938

Japan-Manchoukuo Year Book Co., Tokyo, 1938

Complete scan (printed pp. 624–625 are scanned twice; the repeat is skipped). All statistical tables and columnar lists, the economic barometers, the officials' directory, the Who's Who, the business directory, the Konzerns of Japan, the bibliography, the learned and social institutions, the diplomatic and consular lists and the dated chronologies are transcribed; the running text, photographs, maps, advertisements, organisation charts and charts without printed figures are not. Pages with tables were found from contact sheets. Sonnet 5.5 agents read most pages and Opus 5.5 agents the large or difficult tables; every printed total was re-added, and totals that did not reconcile were re-read on zoomed crops by Opus 5.5 — where the print itself does not add up, the figures are kept as printed and noted. The book's printed contents, with every chapter and section linked to its page of the scan, are on the contents page; that contents list swaps the titles of Supplements I and II, and the links follow the pages.
